Website privacy

A little
clarity.

This page covers kokonut.cc. Haste has its own privacy policy.

Browsing

This website doesn’t use analytics, advertising trackers, sign-up forms or cookies, and it doesn’t write to your browser’s storage. It never asks for your location, camera, microphone or contacts. The “Pause motion” setting lasts for the current page only.

Our hosting and network providers process ordinary request information, like IP addresses, requested pages and browser details, to serve and protect the site. Fonts, scripts, 3D graphics and images all come from this website; no third-party CDN is contacted.

The demos

The Haste meal demo and the Burble filing demo run entirely in your browser. Nothing you pick or type is sent anywhere.

Email and stores

Email links open your own mail app. If you write to us, we use your message only to reply. App Store and Google Play links lead to Apple and Google, which handle those visits under their own privacy terms.
